title: OP Script!
features:
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

🔥 THS v4 FEATURES

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

🧱 New UI System

└─ Completely rebuilt with a professional UI library.

└─ Cleaner, smoother and more stable interface.

└─ Better support for mobile and PC devices.

└─ Improved compatibility with supported executors.

⚡ Optimized Performance

└─ Reduced lag caused by the old custom UI.

└─ Better runtime cleanup system.

└─ Previous script sessions are automatically unloaded.

└─ More stable feature handling.

🔑 New Key System

└─ A key is required to access the script.

└─ Old v3 key is no longer supported.

└─ Invalid keys show warning notifications.

└─ Too many failed attempts trigger a cooldown.

└─ Discord button is included for key access.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

🔥 MAIN FEATURES

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

⛏️ Auto Farm

└─ Automatically farms using available tools.

└─ Supports Auto Sell and Auto Upgrade.

└─ Can be used with Auto Rebirth and Anti AFK.

🧲 Auto Dig

└─ Automatically scans and mines nearby blocks.

└─ Supports selected dig areas.

└─ Auto Best Area option included.

└─ Adjustable scan radius and dig delay.

💰 Auto Sell / Upgrade

└─ Automatically sells at detected sell areas.

└─ Automatically buys better upgrades when possible.

└─ Manual Sell Now and Buy Best Upgrades buttons included.

🎁 Crate Automation

└─ Auto Buy Crates.

└─ Auto Open Crates.

└─ Buy/Open selected crate once.

└─ Custom crate target and delay settings.

📦 Chest ESP

└─ Scans and highlights chests.

└─ Select All / Clear All options.

└─ Valuable Chests Only option.

└─ Colored chest labels by chest type.

🎩 Cosmetics Tools

└─ Clear all skins.

└─ Unequip backpack skin.

└─ Unequip tool skin.

└─ Unequip hat slots.

└─ Toggle hats.

🏃 Movement Tools

└─ Custom WalkSpeed.

└─ Noclip.

└─ Fly.

└─ Infinite Jump.

└─ Reset movement button.

🌍 Teleports

└─ Teleport to Sell Area.

└─ Teleport to Upgrade Shop.

└─ Teleport to nearest selected chest.

└─ Teleport to supported dig areas.

⚙️ Config System

└─ Save Config.

└─ Load Config.

└─ Auto Load support.

└─ Settings are safely validated before loading.

⌨️ Keybinds

└─ Custom keybinds for toggle features.

└─ Unsafe movement keys are blocked.

└─ PageUp toggles the UI visibility.

📱 Mobile Support

└─ Mobile layout scaling.

└─ Mobile THS toggle button.

└─ UI is centered and scaled for smaller screens.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

🎮 CONTROLS

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

⬆️ PageUp

└─ Toggle GUI visibility.

🖱️ Mouse Drag

└─ Drag the window from the title bar.

📱 THS Button

└─ Mobile button for hiding/showing the UI.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

⚠️ WARNINGS

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

⚠️ Server lag may affect Auto Farm / Auto Dig speed.

⚠️ Some executors may not support every function.

⚠️ Config saving requires file API support.

⚠️ If game remotes change, some features may need an update.
